android.desc: From App to Anywhere! With Free2move, access a car whenever you need one – without the costs and commitments of ownership or the hassle of traditional car rentals. Find, book, and unlock a car right from your phone in seconds. Drive by the minute, hour, or day for errands, commutes, business trips, airport runs, weekend escapes, and more. No rental counters. No paperwork. No waiting around. Insurance, fuel or charging, and parking are included, so all you have to do is drive. WHY CHOOSE FREE2MOVE? • Find and unlock a car in seconds with the app • Drive by the minute, hour, or day – and only pay for what you use • Book instantly or reserve ahead for complete flexibility • Insurance, fuel or charging, and parking included • Perfect for personal trips and business travel • Access a growing fleet of electric vehicles across Europe DRIVE BY THE MINUTE Need a car for a quick trip? Perfect for errands, commuting, shopping, and getting around the city. DRIVE BY THE HOUR Ideal for meetings, appointments, visiting friends, or exploring somewhere new. DRIVE BY THE DAY Book a car for up to 30 days for road trips, weekends away, and longer adventures. AIRPORT TRAVEL, MADE EASY Heading to the airport or landing in a new city? Free2move is available at 17 major airport hubs across Europe, making it easy to keep moving wherever your journey takes you. CAR-SHARING FOR BUSINESS Give your team access to vehicles without the hassle of managing a fleet. Create a corporate account, track usage, and stay in control of mobility costs – all from the app. DRIVING THE FUTURE OF MOBILITY Over 30% of the global Free2move fleet is already electric, with several cities operating fully electric fleets. Every shared Free2move vehicle helps reduce congestion and can replace up to 17 privately owned cars. Join the movement. Move freely. Available in 14 car-sharing cities Paris Berlin, Cologne, Düsseldorf, Munich, Hamburg, Frankfurt, Stuttgart Milan, Rome, Turin Vienna Amsterdam Madrid Download Free2move today and unlock a simpler way to drive.
